The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 7. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses The Buyer Added Bid Specific Terms and Condition to be included in Bid are as under: - (i) Bidder financial standing Undertaking: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court re ceivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidders are advised to upload undertaki ng to this effect along with bidding documents. (ii) Experience Criteria :- The Bidder or the OEM of the offered product must have regularly ma nufactured and supplied the same or similar category of products to Central Government/State Go vernment organizations/PSUs during each of FY 2023–24, 2024–25, and 2025–26. Copies of relevan t supply orders/contracts and supporting proof of supply for each financial year shall be uploaded with the bid. For bunch bids, this criterion shall apply to the primary item having the highest estim ated value. (i) Past Project Experience: Please Upload Past project work experience of same or similar pro duct category as per flg: - The Bidder shall have successfully executed, during any one of the last three financial years, i.e., F Y 2023–24, 2024–25, or 2025–26, supply orders for the same or similar product, meeting either of t he following criteria: a) One supply order having either:- a value equal to or more than 80% of the estimated bi d value or a quantity equal to or more than 80% of the required quantity of the primary product in this bid. or b) Two supply orders, executed in the same financial year, each having either:- a value equal to or more than 40% of the estimated bid value or a quantity equal to or more than 40% of the req uired quantity of the primary product in this bid. Copies of the supply orders, along with corresponding CRAC/Receipt-cum- Acceptance Certificate/C ompletion Certificate, shall be uploaded as supporting evidence. (iv) OEM/Bidder annual turnover:- Please upload minimum Annual Turnover/Balance sheet of la st three FY (2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26) duly signed by Charted Accountant. (v) EPBG shall be extended as per the date of completion of supply and 100% amount of EPBG shall be forfeited in the event of failure to deliver all the items fully as per Bid specification. (vi) Bidders are advised to submit original EMD as per bid terms and condition on or before ope ning of technical bid at buyer location, failing which the bid will not be considered. (vii) Payment shall be done only after checking of stores and quality of material by the Board of Officers detailed by CFA. (viii) Material supplied will be checked by the buyer for the items listed in BOQ. The satisfactory results of the checking shall be the sole criteria for acceptance of material and payment thereof. In the event of any/ all of the supplied stores after checking by the board of officers (as detailed by th e buyer) is found deficient in specification/ quantity, the buyer reserves the right to reject the item s and back loaded to the place specified in the invoice at the risk and cost of the seller. (ix) EPBG required from eligible L1 bidder.

(x) Payment - The payment shall be due only after successful supply of complete items in Bid al ong with completion certificate rendered by concerned unit / Board of Officers. (xi) The location is in high altitude area ahead of Tawang and is snow bound. Bidders are advis ed to bid keeping this aspect in mind. (xii) The bid cost shall included total cost of supply of all items and transportation, etc. Nothing extra shall be payable by the buyer subsequently. (xiii) In case of any fraudulent certification/ undertaking found at any stage shall render the bidd er/ seller punishable for departmental action as per GeM policy in vogue. (xiv) Under Taking Certificate: Bidder are advised to upload undertaking certificate to ensure t he offered product must be as per IS Code. (xv) Bid Security submitted by the bidder shall be forfeited, if the bidder a) Withdraws or modifies or impairs or derogates from the bid in any respect within th e period of validity of its bid. b) If it comes to the notice that the information/documents furnished in its bid false, misleading or fraud. c) Fails to furnish requisite performance security within the stipulated time required a s per e-bid/RA conditions. (xvi) Cancellation of bid :- Competent authority will have the right to cancel the bid at any sta ge of procurement process including after opening of financial bid and Reverse Auction without ass igning any reasons to seller. No representation will be entertained in this regard. (xvii) MSE: Bidder if is an MSE then it must have a valid Udyam Registration and whose credenti als will be validated online through Udyam Registration portal as defined in Public Procurement Pol icy for Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs) Order, 2012 dated 23.03.2012 issued by Ministry of Micr o, Small and Medium Enterprises and its subsequent Orders/Notifications issued by concerned Mini stry. Traders are excluded from the purview of Public Procurement Policy for Micro and Small Enter prises and hence resellers offering products manufactured by some other OEM are not eligible for a ny purchase preference. Relevant documentary evidence in this regard shall be uploaded along wi th the bid in respect of the offered product or service and Buyer will decide eligibility for purchase preference based on documentary evidence submitted, while evaluating the bid. Benefits of MSE w ill be allowed only if seller is validated online in GeM profile as well as validated and approved by B uyer after evaluation of documents submitted. (xviii) Online participation in the bidding process does not constitute any guarantee of allowing th e applicant in the bidding process. Opening and admitting of quotation will be decided by the Acce pting Officer based on the eligibility criteria. (xix) No appeal/representation will be entertained after completion of technical or financial bid. No applicant/bidder will be entitled to any compensation whatsoever for rejection or disqualificatio n. (xx) Rates will be quoted as per the accounting unit as indicated in the Bid unless specified oth erwise. (xxi) By quoting for this quotation, the bidder is hereby willingly binding himself to accept and a dhere to the laid down terms & conditions mentioned and Code of Integrity as per GFR 2017. (xxii) Liquidated Damages: If the Seller/Service Provider fails to deliver any or all of the Goods/Se rvices within the original/re-fixed delivery period(s) specified in the contract, the Buyer will be enti tled to deduct/recover the Liquidated Damages for the delay, unless covered under Force Majeure conditions aforesaid, @ 0.5% of the contract value of delayed quantity per week or part of the wee k of delayed period as pre-estimated damages not exceeding 10% of the contract value of delayed quantity without any controversy/dispute of any sort whatsoever. (xxiii) Undertaking: The bidder shall submit an notarized undertaking duly signed by the authorized representative, cer tifying that: a) The bidder/firm is not blacklisted/ debarred by any Government Department, PSU, Autonomous Body or other Government organization as on the date of submission of the bid. b) The bidder/firm is not bankrupt or insolvent, and no bankruptcy/insolvency proceedings are pend ing against the firm as on the date of submission of the bid.

c) The bidder is submitting the bid through one firm only and has not submitted the bid through an y other firm/entity, directly or indirectly, for the same procurement. d) The information and declarations furnished in the undertaking are true and correct to the best of his/her knowledge and belief. Any false declaration or concealment of material facts shall render th e bidder liable for appropriate departmental action as per applicable rules. (xxiv) Compatibility and Verification of Machine Attachments The bidder shall ensure that the machinery attachments offered are fully compatibl e with the existing vehicles/machines for which they are intended. The bidder must verify the mak e, model, technical specifications, mounting arrangements, hydraulic/electrical connections and ot her relevant parameters either through a physical site visit or by obtaining the necessary technical details from the Buyer through other suitable means. The successful bidder shall ensure proper fit ment and satisfactory operation before supply. Any attachment found incompatible with the specifi ed vehicle/machine shall be replaced or rectified by the Seller at their own risk and cost, without a dditional financial liability to the Buyer. . 20. Turnover Bidder Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the bidder during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the bidder is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. 21. Turnover OEM Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the OEM of the offered product during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the OEM is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. In case of bunch bids, the OEM of CATEGORY RELATED TO primary product having highest bid value should meet this criterion. 22.
